objectives: 學習如何分析土木工程相關固體力學領域之各類問題，瞭解材料或結構實際力學行為之物理現象，以為日後土木工程設計之基礎。
content:
Course Contents:
1. Stress 1.1 - 1.5 (1.6-1.7)
2. Strain 2.1 - 2.2
3. Mechanical Properties of Materials 3.1 - 3.7
4. Axial Load 4.1 - 4.6 (4.7)
5. Torsion 5.1 - 5.2, 5.4 - 5.5 (5.3, 5.8)
6. Bending 6.1 - 6.4, 6.6 (6.9)
7. Transverse Shear 7.1 - 7.4
8. Defections of Beams and Shafts 12.1 - 12.2, 12.5
9. Combined Loadings 8.1 - 8.2
10. Stress Transformation 9.1 - 9.4
11. Strain Transformation 10.1 - 10.3; 10.5 - 10.6
12. Buckling of Columns 13.1 - 13.3
books:
Textbook: Mechanics of Materials by R.C Hibbeler
(10th Edition, Taiwan adaped version)
Reference: Mechanics of Materials by B.J Goodno and J.M Gere
(Brief 2nd Edition in SI Units)
grading_policy:
1st Exam 25％
2nd Exam 25％
Final Exam 30％
Homeworks 5％
Rollcall 5％
